TrapWin Limiter v2.5 - Windows & macOS (VST3 / AU / CLAP)
==========================================================

Thank you for buying TrapWin Limiter!

REQUIREMENTS
  Windows: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit - VST3 or CLAP host
  macOS:   macOS 10.15 or newer, Intel or Apple Silicon - VST3, AU or CLAP host
  Works in 64-bit hosts such as FL Studio, Ableton Live, Logic Pro (AU),
  Reaper, Studio One, Cubase, Bitwig. OpenGL graphics required.

WINDOWS - INSTALLER (recommended)
  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Run TrapWin_Limiter_v2.5_Windows_Setup.exe and click through the steps.
  3. Open your DAW and rescan plugins
       FL Studio: Options > Manage plugins > Find installed plugins
       Ableton:   Preferences > Plug-ins > Rescan
       Reaper:    Options > Preferences > Plug-ins > VST > Re-scan

WINDOWS - MANUAL INSTALL (ZIP)
  Copy the folder "TrapLimit.vst3" into
         C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  Optional CLAP: copy "TrapLimit.clap" into
         C:\Program Files\Common Files\CLAP\
  Then rescan plugins in your DAW.

MACOS
  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Double-click TrapWin_Limiter_v2.5_macOS.pkg and follow the installer.
     Pick the formats you need: VST3, Audio Unit (Logic Pro / GarageBand), CLAP.
  3. Open your DAW. Logic Pro scans new Audio Units automatically; in other
     hosts rescan plugins.
  Installed to /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3, /Components and /CLAP.

Find the plugin as "TrapWin Limiter" (vendor: TrapWin).

UPDATING
  Install the new version over the old one. Old projects open normally -
  the plugin ID did not change.

UNINSTALL
  Windows: Settings > Apps > TrapWin Limiter > Uninstall
           (or delete C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\TrapLimit.vst3)
  macOS:   delete TrapLimit.vst3 / TrapLimit.component / TrapLimit.clap from
           /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3, /Components and /CLAP
  Your own presets: %APPDATA%\TrapVST\Limiter\Presets (Windows)
                    ~/.trapvst/limiter/presets (macOS)

Full user guide: "TrapWin Limiter - Manual.pdf"
License terms:   EULA.txt

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
INSTALACE (cesky)
  Windows: spust TrapWin_Limiter_v2.5_Windows_Setup.exe a proklikej instalaci.
           Nebo rucne: slozku "TrapLimit.vst3" zkopiruj do
           C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  macOS:   dvakrat klikni na TrapWin_Limiter_v2.5_macOS.pkg a projdi instalaci
           (VST3, AU pro Logic Pro/GarageBand, CLAP).
  Pak v DAW znovu vyhledej pluginy. Plugin najdes jako "TrapWin Limiter".
